caption_L1: This line graph is labeled Life expectancy (from birth) in the Netherlands , from 1800 to 2020. There is a linear scale from 0 to 80 along the y-axis, marked Life expectancy in years. Year is drawn on the x-axis.
caption_L2L3: This shows a general increase in life expectancy in the netherlands. However, there have been several decreases, notably aroud 1860, 1870, 1920 and 1940. It increased most dramatically between 1870 and 1920.
